title: Omega Landing Structure
question: The roll assigned the Particle Detector. Keep it, explore an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Particle Detector Event Display
options.lineage: Scientific notation: CERN particle physics event visualization
options.thesis: Orders as collision events: tracks curve through detector rings, calorimeter bars show fills, concentric topology proves technical credibility.
options.viewport: Center collision at viewport center. Concentric detector rings. Yellow/cyan tracks radiating outward. Red calorimeter energy bars on right edge. Hero headline sits above collision. Who/Why/Signup orbit around the detector.
options.risk: Radical departure from linear scroll. Requires 3D or complex SVG animation to feel authentic.

options.label: Streaming Catalog Wall
options.lineage: Netflix/streaming tile carousel: horizontally scrolling rows that expand on focus
options.thesis: Who/Why/Signup as expandable tiles. Center mechanism as the hero row. Browse then deep-dive into each option.
options.viewport: Three horizontal rows: Mechanism (hero), Who/Why (two tiles), Signup (carousel). Focused tile lifts and reveals metadata. Rest of wall dims behind it.
options.case: Clean topology for exploration. Loses on wow-factor vs. detector collision.
options.risk: Familiar pattern; reads less technical/infrastructure than the roll.

options.label: Sneaker Box Archive
options.lineage: Product archive: stacked boxes with silhouettes, pull and reveal
options.thesis: Order types stacked as boxes. Pull a box, lid opens to reveal flow path and stats. Tactile metaphor for exploring order routes.
options.viewport: Wall of stacked boxes (order types). Pull a box to slide it out. Lid hinges open showing the 4-step flow inside. Tissue paper aesthetic.
options.case: Tangible, delightful metaphor. Kept: the stacked exploration pattern. Lost: does not read as technical/infrastructure.
options.risk: Feels more product/retail than institutional execution venue.

reroll.safer: Show me composition variants that feel more familiar.
reroll.bolder: Show me structures from completely foreign domains.
